Name: Cakes and Creams
Author: vyranity
Description:
[left]﻿﻿[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/12244/12244-1654439826-1860140431.png[/img]﻿
[size=3]﻿This mod adds [b]29 delicious cakes[/b] that can be made using your kitchen. ﻿
However if you want to make the cakes profitable, you can choose to make them using [b]the machines[/b] as they are worth (1.5x) more when made using them.

All of the cakes can be crafted using a piece of fruit combined with [b]flour, sugar, an egg and milk[/b] (with a few exceptions).
However some of the cakes have other mod dependencies (PPJA fruits and veggies and PPJA artisan valley for the chocolate, red velvet and carrot cakes) (you can still use this mod without these mods installed)[/size][/left][size=3]
